sentences.text:
THESE PETITIONS COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

Petitioners who claim to have established business of distributing potable drinking water (RO) for needy public for Tiptur for affordable prices are calling in question seizure orders dated 09.03.2018 issued by third respondent as per Annexures-A to A5.
2.
Heard the arguments of Sri Shanumukhappa, learned Senior Counsel appearing for petitioners and Sri Srinidhi, learned AGA appearing for respondents.
Perused the records.

3. Petitioners are claiming to be registered drinking water suppliers and said to have dug borewells,
installed RO plants (Reverse Osmosis Potable Drinking Water Plants) for supplying clean drinking water and transporting the same to the needy public at very affordable prices.
Petitioners have also obtained permission from the Town Municipality to install the R.O Plants as per Annexures-D to D4.

Certificate issued by private testing laboratories certifying that water being supplied by the petitioners are potable and good for human consumption is produced as Annexures-E and E1 dated 16.09.2016 and 27.01.2017.
4.
Notices came to be issued by third respondent calling upon the petitioners to close their units since they do not have ISI certification without which they cannot sell water.
Said notices have been replied by petitioners as per Annexures-G to G3.

It is the grievance of the petitioners that despite such reply given, third respondent - authority has proceeded to seize their units and as such, their fundamental right to carry on business is affected and public in need of clean drinking water are also being deprived of potable RO water at affordable price.
Hence, they have sought for quashing of the impugned notices/orders.

5. Petitioners have filed affidavits on 26.06.2018 stating thereunder to the effect that they would file necessary application before the appropriate authority for grant of ISI certificate in respect of water to be sold by them within 14 days from the date of receipt of copy of the order and as such, they have prayed for six months time to obtain necessary permissions have also sought for direction to respondent to lift seizure of their units to enable them to run their business.
6.
Learned Advocate appearing for petitioners have reiterated the grounds urged in the writ petitions.

7. Division Bench of this Court of which Aravind Kumar J was a member, in the case of LOCHAMESH B. HUGAR vs UNION OF INDIA, MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE DEPARTMENT AND OTHERS reported in ILR 2013 KAR 306 has held that Central Government Madhu B M vs State Of Karnataka on 27 June, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42738504/
3 having brought in Food, Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sale) Regulations,
2011 which mandates sale of packaged drinking water is notified except under BIS certification and same having come into effect from 05.08.2011 had directed respondent - authorities to take all necessary steps to prohibit, prevent the manufacture or sale of packaged drinking water without certification from the Bureau of Indian Standards.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Division Bench has also directed respondent-authorities to take action against the manufacturers of packaged drinking water if found to be running the units without certification from the Bureau of Indian Standards.

Further direction was also issued to the authorities to dispose of the applications which are pending for grant of certification within a time frame as indicated in the order dated 09.11.2012.
8.

In the light of said directions issued by the Division Bench and affidavits now having been filed by the petitioners herein undertaking to obtain certificate from Bureau of Indian Standards, this Court is of the considered view that petitioners are selling the water though not under packaged container but by cans, the fact remains that said water is being sold for human consumption and as such,
petitioners
cannot be heard to contend that they need not obtain BIS certification.

9. In that view of the matter, by placing the affidavits of undertaking given by the petitioners on record and contentions raised by learned Advocate appearing for petitioners that petitioners may be directed to obtain certification from Chief Food Analyst, State Food Laboratory, Public Health Institute Building, Sheshadri Road, K.R.Circle, Bengaluru who shall certify as to the potability of water being sold by the petitioners, these writ petitions can be disposed of.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (1) Writ petitions stand disposed of reserving liberty to petitioners to file applications before the Chief Food Analyst, State Food Laboratory, Public Health Institute Building, Sheshadri Road, K.R.Circle, Bengaluru within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and on receipt of said applications, said authority shall examine the same and issue certificate about potability of the water being sold by the petitioners.
(2) On such certificate being obtained and produced by the petitioners before third respondent, he shall forthwith restore possession of the units to the petitioner and permit them to use/run the units and shall immediately lift the seizure of petitioners'
units.

(3) For the purpose of obtaining sample water from the units, third respondent shall open the lock and enable the petitioner to provide water sample as they desire to obtain water from the unit and produce the same before the Chief Food Analyst for being analysed and certified.

(4) Petitioners shall also submit applications to the Bureau of Indian Standards as prescribed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Regulations made thereunder and as provided under Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 for issuance Madhu B M vs State Of Karnataka on 27 June, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42738504/
4 of certificate for manufacture/sale of water within three weeks from the date of receipt of certification from the Chief Food Analyst as ordered hereinabove.
